brief:
Al-Monitor examined how journalists in Gaza continue covering the war despite direct personal impact. Reporters working in the territory face the challenge of maintaining professional standards while experiencing displacement, injury, and loss of family members. The piece explores the emotional and logistical toll on news workers who must document conflict while navigating the same dangers affecting their communities.

Journalists operating in Gaza have adapted their reporting methods as infrastructure deteriorates and security conditions worsen. Many continue filing stories from shelters or temporary locations, balancing the responsibility to inform the public with the immediate demands of survival and family safety.

title: Gaza journalists report amid personal loss and displacement
